entries.descriptionOriginal: Players start as Initiates. The first Initiate to claim the Relic becomes the Chosen One. Only the Chosen One can score points by eliminating Initiates. The remaining Initiates try to eliminate the Chosen One and claim the Relic for themselves. Claim the Relic and become the Chosen One before everybody else! Only the Chosen One can score points when eliminating Initiates. A golden beacon follows and heals the Chosen One, but it also reveals their location to Initiates. Keep moving to stay alive!
